summary.text: A. Shane Massey is a Republican member of the South Carolina Senate for District 25, which covers Aiken, Edgefield, Lexington, McCormick and Saluda Counties, serving since November 6, 2007.
He is the Senate Majority Leader and chairs the Rules Committee.

paragraphs.text: Massey was born on June 28, 1975, in Greeneville, Tennessee, and is an attorney.
His official page lists a B.A. from Clemson University in 1997 and a J.D. from the University of South Carolina in 2000.
He has served in the Senate since November 6, 2007.
His committees are Corrections and Penology, Education, Judiciary, Labor, Commerce and Industry, Legislative Oversight, and Rules (chairman).
